description: This file defines a React component for an AI quiz page within a learner dashboard. It manages state for selected course, difficulty, and modal visibility, fetches course data, and renders UI elements for starting quizzes, viewing past attempts, and navigating courses. It also includes logic for initializing data and handling user interactions.

methods.name: AiQuizPage
methods.description: React functional component rendering the AI quiz page, managing user interaction and state.
